title: What Makes it Ok to Set a Fire? Iterative Self-distillation of Contexts and Rationales for Disambiguating Defeasible Social and Moral Situations
reasoning: The entire paper is dedicated to the task of 'defeasible moral reasoning', which involves evaluating and benchmarking how context affects the moral and social acceptability of actions. It introduces the δ-RULES-OF-THUMB (δ-ROT) dataset specifically to study human moral judgment and social norms in LLMs.
